title: Murder Party
review: I really like the Jeremy Saulnier's later work, outside of horror. There's elements of his style developing here, but I think it's let down a bit by the writing and some flat performances. I think there are lots of Tarantino influences here, but it doesn't come close to matching the quality of his dialogue. It was his first film, with a tiny budget, and I'm not holding it against him in light of his more professional career. Some of the jokes made me laugh, mostly the visual ones, and Christopher's eyebrow acting. I like that there was a PSP in it; they were cool in 2007. He has a new horror movie coming out named {Slayground} that looks particularly dumb, and I hope it's dumb and good.
